reason: Design review only. All nine public cases give observable positive and negative coverage for their acceptance criteria. Each has forbidden behavior and counterexamples that separate the intended result from a plausible wrong one. C-7 now separates ordinary and required modes across unset, empty, "0" and "1". Ordinary mode without a record gives exactly one labelled skip that never certifies. Required mode without a record fails the required-file assertion with no skip. Required mode with the real record runs every live-receipt assertion with zero skips. The runner rejects a missing mode selection and any skipped C-7 result. Candidate-revision binding, missing-stage and synthetic-provider rejections are preserved. No product requirement is waived.
